name: RefMD MCP Server
description: Enables chatbots to browse, search, create, and edit Markdown documents stored in RefMD through a hosted SSE endpoint with OAuth 2.1 authentication.

rawRecord.description: Enables chatbots to browse, search, create, and edit Markdown documents stored in RefMD through a hosted SSE endpoint with OAuth 2.1 authentication.

MCP_DB_URL.description: Optional connection string for the configured driver (e.g. postgres://user:pass@host/db). For SQLite you may omit this and use MCP_DB_SQLITE_PATH.

OAUTH_ISSUER.description: Optional public issuer URL (defaults to the current request origin)

MCP_DB_DRIVER.description: Optional. Set to sqlite, postgres, or mysql to persist OAuth tokens. Defaults to in-memory storage.

REFMD_API_BASE.description: Base URL of your RefMD API (e.g. https://refmd.example.com)

OAUTH_CLIENT_IDS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed client_id values. Leave empty to allow any.

MCP_DB_SQLITE_PATH.description: Optional filesystem path for SQLite storage. Accepts plain paths or file:/// URLs; ensure the path resolves to persistent storage when using SQLite.

OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed redirect URIs. Defaults to allowing HTTPS URLs and http://localhost. Include ChatGPT's callback URL.
